competitions.title: Cash Rush Competition
competitions.field_context: Campus startup simulation competing under strict 120-minute time constraint with ₹300 seed capital.

service_breakdown.name: Mind-reading website
service_breakdown.mechanism: Interactive website ending with QR code redirecting to LinkedIn as a curiosity hook

service_breakdown.name: Campus quiz challenge
service_breakdown.mechanism: Winners got paid, losers paid the squad

story.setup: Teams got ₹300 and 120 minutes to grow it on campus however they could.
story.key_decision: We sold experiences, not goods: a mind-reading website that ended on a QR to LinkedIn as a curiosity hook, a quiz challenge where winners got paid and losers paid us, and on-the-spot caricatures. No inventory, so almost every rupee earned was margin. Total costs were ₹45 (paper and a marker).
story.result: Services brought in ₹2,400 (₹1,050 mind-reading, ₹550 quiz, ₹800 caricatures). The fund ended at ₹2,655: 1st place and the ₹7,000 prize.
story.takeaway: Sell what costs nothing to produce. With 120 minutes on the clock, experiences beat inventory.

competitions.title: CINE-SELL Brand Challenge
competitions.field_context: Competing against MBA cohorts from top B-schools across India.
deliverables: Market research dossier on telephone product positioning
Promotional video reel directed by Rudra
Live stage commercial skit featuring Bollywood character mimicry

story.setup: A national marketing fest challenge with ~700 registered teams where squads had to sell a telephone using Bollywood-inspired characters.
story.key_decision: Led "Team Big 4" as a first-year undergrad Team Lead—coordinating market research, directing the promotional reel, and anchoring Sahaj's character mimicry act with our commercial pitch.
story.result: Cleared screening rounds to finish in the Top 3 National Finalists, ranking in the top 3 of ~700 teams, most of them postgraduate B-school cohorts.

competitions.title: Advertising & Brand Pitch
competitions.field_context: Offline university brand pitch sprint representing Rishihood University.

story.setup: Represented Rishihood University offline at DCRUST E-Summit '26. Teams were assigned a consumer soap brand and given 45 minutes to build a full campaign from scratch.
story.key_decision: Divided the 45-minute window across four concrete deliverables—a promotional poster, a short filmed ad, a live skit, and a product pitch for the stage round.
story.result: Finished 3rd Position Podium overall and won the ₹1,100 cash prize.

ventures.name: Tathya (तथ्य)
ventures.status_detail: Early research · eval set in progress
ventures.thesis: Research into how LLMs fail on non-standard Indian dialects (Punjabi, Haryanvi, Bhojpuri), and a verification layer to catch those failures.
ventures.problem: LLMs perform poorly on regional dialects due to token fragmentation.
features: Custom evaluation benchmark for Haryanvi, Punjabi, and Bhojpuri
Verification layer for government schemes and regional queries

lines.text: Research phase · building Haryanvi / Punjabi / Bhojpuri eval set

ventures.problem: Hiring case studies are easily generated using LLMs without testing live judgment.

ventures.name: Flow State
ventures.status_detail: Local build · Zero-OAuth sync & 16-bit procedural audio synthesis
ventures.thesis: A deep-work workflow and focus-session desktop environment built to eliminate cloud telemetry leaks and context switching for developers.
ventures.problem: Cloud telemetry leaks and context switching fragment developer focus.
features: 16-bit 44.1kHz procedural audio synthesis via math.sin (0 MP3 files)
Weekly focus receipts with 30-day productivity telemetry

ventures.name: Krama (क्रम)
ventures.thesis: An offline-first academic schedule optimization and attendance recovery calculus utility designed to eliminate surprise eligibility shortages below the mandatory 75% threshold.
ventures.problem: Mandatory attendance cutoffs (75%) trigger sudden academic disqualifications without proactive recovery visibility.
features: Safe leave buffer calculation and recovery calculus
Encrypted local SQLite storage with zero account creation required
